Initialize Register.description: Initialize a register with a literal value

body: c${1:2} = c${1:2} - c${2:3} ; Decrement loop counter
CONTROL ${3:7} IF c${1:2} > c${4:4} ; Jump to line ${3:7} if counter > 0
Control Loop.description: Create a standard decrementing control loop

body: c5 = c0 + c1      ; Calculate next Fibonacci number
c0 = c1           ; Shift Variable B into Variable A
c1 = c5           ; Shift Next Number into Variable B
c2 = c2 - c3      ; Decrement loop counter
CONTROL 7 IF c2 > c4 ; If counter > 0, jump back to Line 7
